QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_68

question.text: An AIF has initial Set-up Cost of INR 2.5 crore (incl. GST), amortised over the fund life of 5 years. Set-up cost charged to Year 1 P&L of the fund:

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook's set-up-cost treatment allows amortisation over the fund life. Straight-line amortisation: INR 2.5 crore / 5 years = INR 0.50 crore charged in Year 1. The Trap: Option B expenses the entire set-up cost upfront. Option C uses the wrong denominator. Option D doubles the cost. Note: Amortising one-fifth of a 5-year set-up cost each year matches the workbook's illustrative example.
